description: Produce visual PR evidence — a screenshot or video — whenever a change has on-screen impact. Tests are never a substitute; a change can be backend by cause and visible by effect. Capture via the project's e2e harness on a pu box, or by driving a live kolu with the chrome-devtools MCP; host on a GitHub release and post a `## Evidence` comment. Triggers on "post evidence", "screenshot the change", "record a video of this", "show it working", "prove it", or finishing any change whose effect is visible on screen.
